name: cookidoo-openapi
description: Unofficial OpenAPI specification for the observed Cookidoo web API

scripts.bundle: npm run prepare:output && redocly bundle cookidoo@v0 --output dist/openapi.yaml
scripts.docs: npm run prepare:output && redocly build-docs cookidoo@v0 --output dist/index.html --disableGoogleFont --theme.openapi.disableTelemetry
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test:source && npm run bundle && npm run types && npm run types:check && npm run docs && npm run test:artifacts
